ITEM TYPE: PALIMPSEST CROSS-INSTRUMENT ANALYSIS

China's information controls must be read as separate content, network, erasure, and distribution measurements rather than one seductive national score.

The board detects movement, not motive

No current finding is published for Board alarm because the source status is stale. The board statistic tests whether named signals moved beyond their own histories; it does not identify one cause for the movement. No current finding is published for Coverage guard because the source status is stale.

Attention, silence, and erasure answer different questions

No current finding is published for Deletion-directive term index because the source status is stale. No current finding is published for Silence index because the source status is stale. No current finding is published for Erasure observatory because the source status is stale. The directive index counts provenance-bound terms, the silence index tests a predeclared blackout rule, and the erasure index summarizes heterogeneous layers; placing them together does not create one censorship rate.

Network measurements agree on scope, not on one denominator

No current finding is published for Network vantage fusion because the source status is stale. No current finding is published for OONI Great Firewall index because the source status is stale. No current finding is published for Inside-China view because the source status is stale. The fused index, volunteer-probe aggregate, and fixed inside-China panel use different samples and protocols, so none can be substituted for a national share of traffic or users.

App availability needs both a fixed panel and a broad corpus

No current finding is published for App Storefront panel because the source status is stale. No current finding is published for AppleCensorship corpus because the source status is stale. The fixed panel supports controlled same-round comparison, while the broad corpus improves catalogue coverage; neither percentage identifies why an individual app is absent.

What today's reading can support

At the edition clock, 0 of 10 selected instruments publish current claims and 10 publish availability warnings instead. The defensible conclusion is a layered description of current observations, not a single estimate of censorship prevalence or intent.
